facebookAccount.notes: Automatically retrieves new cookies every x minutes. Recommended: 1440 (1 day).

noPrefix.notes: true = only bot admins can use commands without prefix | false = everyone must use prefix

reactUnsend.notes: If enable = true, bot will unsend any message reacted with these emojis. If onlyAdmin = true, only adminBot IDs can trigger it.

whiteListMode.notes: If enabled, only IDs in whiteListIds can use the bot.

whiteListModeThread.notes: If enabled, only threads in whiteListThreadIds can use the bot.

autoRestart.notes: Example: 60000 (1min), 3600000 (1hr), 0 0 * * * (daily). Currently set to restart daily at 4 AM.

twoIdMode.notes: Set enable to true and paste a second Facebook account's cookies into account2.txt to turn this on. If the primary account (account.txt) fails to log in / gets logged out this many times in a row, the bot automatically swaps in the account2.txt cookies and keeps running instead of staying offline.

autoUptime.notes: Time in seconds. Recommended for uptime monitors.

restartListenMqtt.notes: Restart listener every 15 min. Logs showed message_reaction deltas from Facebook silently stop arriving after ~20-25 min on a single MQTT session (no error/close ever fires, so the normal error-based reconnect never kicks in) while normal messages keep flowing fine. The old 1-hour interval let the bot sit ~40 min with reactions completely dead before self-healing. 15 min keeps it comfortably under that failure window.

notiWhenListenMqttError.notes: Notification settings when MQTT stops listening.

optionsFca.notes: Docs: https://github.com/ntkhang03/fb-chat-api/blob/master/DOCS.md#apisetoptionsoptions | Set reactionDebug to true temporarily to log the full message_reaction pipeline (raw event, dispatch, Map lookup, handler result) if reactions ever stop firing again.
